reason: v2 fails two complete-observation cap=1.5 truth points. Some estimates enter cap<one-credit, where cap cancels completely from normalized timing; local Fisher constraints at truth do not distinguish that branch.
retained_scope: All v2 exposure cells, nuisance conditions, truth points and error criteria. Keep all v2 counts; add independent probes only at N=4, delay=0.125 seconds, interference=0.
separation_model: For complete-observation one-mode prefixes and cap below the one-event increment, both reference first-pattern fractions are <=0.5. Compare each truth distribution at the calibration cell with the entire two-fraction box [0,0.5]^2.
distance: Minimum Bhattacharyya distance: -log(sum_record sqrt(p_truth*p_alternative)), including missing detection. Maximize affinity over the two-fraction box with analytic gradients. This is an engineering separation criterion, not an error guarantee for a continuous composite alternative.
selection: Smallest candidate total count at the calibration cell yielding expected distance >=8 for every one of the 36 complete-condition truth points. Apply this same count to all three nuisance conditions and preserve all other counts.
fit_revision: After selecting the lowest-loss converged interior candidate with the v2 procedures, require rank three in its expected physical-record Fisher information at the actual allocation. A rank-deficient best candidate is a failed fit, not replaced by a higher-loss identifiable candidate or clipped to a new cap bound.
